 --> Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai actress Navika Kotia ends engagement to businessman Mazen Mody due to compatibility issues: Report
 Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai actress Navika Kotia has reportedly called off her engagement to businessman Mazen Mody after facing compatibility issues. 
 M Snehanjali 
 October 27, 2026 / 21:40 IST Share --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 The couple got engaged in January 2026 and were planning to get married next year before they broke off their engagement. 
 Television actress Navika Kotia, best known for her role in Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai, has reportedly called off her engagement to Pune-based businessman Mazen Mody.
 The couple got engaged in January 2026 and were planning to get married next year. However, differences between them reportedly led to their decision to part ways in early July.
 According to a report by The Times of India, Navika and Mazen mutually decided to end their engagement after realising they were not compatible. The decision was reportedly amicable, with neither of them holding any hard feelings towards the other.
 A source quoted by the publication said, “It was an arranged match. They had performed the gol dhana ceremony in January and were planning to tie the knot next year. However, they started facing issues and realised they were very different from each other. So they decided to part ways. There is no negativity surrounding the breakup, and they have both moved on."
 Navika and Mazen were introduced through a mutual friend and had known each other for around a year before their families began discussing marriage. In an earlier interview with Hindustan Times, the actress had revealed that their roka ceremony took place in November last year.
 Following reports of the broken engagement, Mazen has reportedly moved on and is now in a relationship with actor Ritika Badiani, as suggested by his social media updates.
 Mazen has shared posts on social media with several glimpses of Ritika and him together.
 Also read:  Chiranjeevi to host Netflix talk show MEGAVerse, Brahmanandam, Sunil likely to join first episode 
 Navika began her acting career as a child artist, appearing in television shows such as Kasamh Se, Baa Bahoo Aur Baby and Balika Vadhu. She gained wider recognition for playing Sridevi's daughter in the 2012 film English Vinglish.
 Navika further continued to appear in Television shows such as Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai in 2022 after taking a break for 8 years to complete her studies. In the show, she played Maya "Mau" Khera, a grey-shaded character. She later took on her first lead role as Kesar in Kyunki Saas Maa Bahu Beti Hoti Hai.
 M Snehanjali is a Sub Editor and journalist with over two years of experience covering general news and entertainment in digital newsroom.
